about.title: About CosmicTalks
about.subtitle: Astrology across traditions — presented with modern clarity.
about.p1: CosmicTalks is an astrology platform for modern seekers. Explore free Janam Kundli (Lahiri sidereal chart engine), Western learning guides, KP tools, numerology calculators, daily horoscope, Panchang and AI chart chat — in English and Hindi.
about.p2: Your birth chart uses India’s widely used Lahiri method with whole-sign houses and Vimshottari dasha. Other sections cover different systems for different questions — we keep methods clear so you know what you are reading.
about.p3: Deeper consultation covers timing, compatibility, remedies and life decisions with a human guide. The experience stays calm, bright and trustworthy while you explore.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Clear answers before you generate your chart.
faq.a1: Yes for accurate Lagna and house placements. If time is unknown, Moon-based themes can still be discussed in consultation.
faq.q2: Which astrology systems do you cover?
faq.a2: CosmicTalks covers multiple traditions. Free Janam Kundli uses Lahiri sidereal methods. You can also explore Western guides, KP calculators, numerology tools, horoscope and Panchang — each labelled by system so you know what you are using.
faq.a3: We share high-level indications on the site. Personalized remedies are shared after a private consultation with us.
faq.a4: Your chart is calculated while you use the site. For consultations, we only use what you choose to share with us.
faq.q5: Can I get the report in Hindi?
faq.a5: Yes — switch language anytime. The pages and kundli explanations support Hindi and English.
faq.a6: Ayanamsa is the correction that aligns planet positions with the fixed stars. The Lahiri method is India’s most widely used official standard (also used in the national panchang). Our kundli uses this method.
